carrier.source: linear span of the six 3x3 permutation-link vacua
carrier.representationMeaning: the image of the three-point permutation representation of R[S3], with the absent sign irrep removed
carrier.adaptedForm: X = diag(a,R) in the common-line plus trace-zero-plane basis, with R in M2(R)

harmonicRestriction.underMixedC6Step: 1 plus a fundamental real two-plane plus a second-harmonic real two-plane
harmonicRestriction.interpretation: sheet parity is not an independent linear mode; it is recovered nonlinearly by determinant

quadraticForm.normalizationBoundary: the relative positive scale between det(R) and a^2 is not fixed by the finite representation; the signature is stable
quadraticForm.orientationBoundary: det(R) is a cross-carrier oriented-area comparison and requires correlated orientations of the two A2 planes

vacuumCausalClasses.warning: the mixed C6 step exchanges these classes and therefore does not preserve Q

symmetryBoundary.preservesQ: the orientation-correlated subgroup of S3_family x S3_placement, including the vacuum diagonal S3
symmetryBoundary.doesNotPreserveQ: an independent reflection on only one endpoint and the parity-changing mixed C6 step
symmetryBoundary.spinStatement: the normalized carrier is a real quadratic space of type (2,3), so its full connected isometry spin cover would be Spin(2,3); the corpus has not derived that full isometry group as a physical symmetry

verdict: The minimal linear carrier of the six relative frames is five-dimensional and admits a natural orientation-dependent quadratic form of signature (2,3). This explains a Spin(2,3)-shaped envelope but does not derive Spin(2,3) dynamics.
